In repeated-record JSON such as PROJECT_GRAPH.json, an apply_patch hunk anchored only on common fields (for example github_repo=null plus status=archive) can modify the first matching record while later hunks modify the intended record. Anchor every hunk on the record’s unique id and verify both the target record and any earlier structurally similar record before committing.

pgrep -fc PATTERN prints the count 0 AND exits non-zero when nothing matches, so the common idiom N=$(pgrep -fc PATTERN || echo 0) yields the two-line string '0\n0' rather than '0', and any [ "$N" = "0" ] idle check silently never fires. Observed concretely: a verification harness waited 300s for an already-idle host, then took its abort branch, three times in a row, while the host had zero matching processes throughout. Use N=$(pgrep -f PATTERN | wc -l | tr -d ' ') instead - wc -l always emits exactly one number and the pipeline exit status comes from wc, not pgrep. Same trap applies to grep

Company Planning: declaring a profile illustrative is insufficient when common policy, templates, runtime validators, and composition tests still branch on its label; those branches make the profile operationally mandatory. Encode behavior from independent decision factors and test the absence of unnecessary artifacts, questions, and transitions instead.

Codex CLI 0.149 does not recognize /learned or /prompts:learned as commands. Its tested native manual route for an installed user skill is /skills followed by selecting learned, which inserts a direct $learned mention into the composer. Treat either the selector or a user-typed $learned mention as manual-command provenance, and do not install a ~/.codex/prompts/learned.md adapter.

Project Meta's 2026-08-19 DoDAF accretion diagnosis became a 25-repository accretion-detector and doc-coupling rollout by 2026-08-20. The rollout completion evidence measures control coverage, not improvement in a user-visible product outcome. This is a portfolio amplification mode: a local product-path failure can generate fleet-wide maintenance work faster than the repaired product path is validated.

Causal Trace's zero-call preflight validated model policy, explicit reasoning effort, call and token envelopes, and the application budget, yet the sole authorized Luna provider dispatch received OpenRouter HTTP 402 for insufficient billing-account credits and returned no model output or usage record. Model-call configuration readiness and provider billing-credit readiness are separate. Before a scarce one-shot observation, use an account-routed non-spending credit check when available; otherwise explicitly disclose that credit readiness is unverified. A 402 does not imply permission to retry.

A Codex thread restart does not load a newly merged local-marketplace plugin cachebuster unless the marketplace source checkout has first been synchronized and the plugin reinstalled. Before behavioral evaluation, verify both the enabled plugin version and the session's loaded skill-cache path; otherwise a fresh thread can still exercise stale guidance.

A semantic-precision threshold over only emitted relationships can be satisfied through abstention: CREST v2 scored 3/3 supported after emissions fell from 79 edges across five documents to 3 edges across two, with guards tuned on the same candidate set. A decision-grade gate therefore needs precommitted yield or source-first coverage, unseen same-class cases, a fresh untuned run, and blind adjudication in addition to an emitted-edge precision threshold.

In repositories that intentionally Git-ignore raw recovery archives, a tracked recovery manifest and healthy GitHub history prove only metadata and tracked-history preservation, not the archive's physical presence. KGAS still had its recovery manifest while the raw archive was absent from the current machine and from GitHub. Before declaring preservation complete, verify the named source host, materialize an independent copy, compare source and destination counts plus checksums, and integrity-test a separate recovery artifact.

Humour repository strategy audit: escalating a small personal hobby project into a 50-prompt multi-rater evaluation with paid human judgments failed the user's cost and intent constraints. For subjective creative hobby tools, begin from first principles: the desired play loop, the owner's taste, reversibility, and a hard couple-dollar experiment ceiling. Use informal owner inspection only as design feedback, not publication-grade evidence. Project Meta Principle 30 already requires first-principles choice before benchmarking; apply it before proposing any evaluation machinery.

Causal Trace’s Luna analyzer returned useful structured reasoning but mechanically changed two purported quotations by omitting Wikipedia citation markers and changing source-internal capitalization. Prompt-only exact-copy instructions are not a sufficient grounding boundary. When a sufficiently long case-folded word sequence occurs exactly once, deterministic code can map it back to the exact source character span, including narrow citation markers; ambiguous, short, or word-changed text must remain blocked. Using an existing current OntoCanon result through the actual DoDAF consumer before a fresh provider run exposed that source wording about outputs supporting inputs had become two non-identical governed resources. The no-spend consumer probe corrected the roadmap and prevented a false complete-exchange claim; future producer-consumer integrations should exercise the downstream join before paying for new generation.

Behavioral planning-skill evaluations cannot grade a generic artifact field as planning ceremony unless the schema distinguishes planning/control artifacts from user-requested deliverables and implementation or test evidence. In Company Planning PR #133, the initial grader treated a launch brief, implementation diff, and test evidence as unwanted planning artifacts, creating false excess-ceremony failures; regrading baseline and candidate symmetrically using only planning/control artifacts changed the aggregate interpretation without altering model outputs. The critic therefore found that the hypotheses were asymmetric and that E1–E4 did not actually challenge H2 despite their supports/challenges labels. Rival hypotheses must differ on a contested mechanism or causal weight, and evidence is discriminative only when it would be less expected under one rival; facts conceded by both belong to the shared causal story, not the challenge set. Enforced Planning's documentation-authority ownership resolver filters live claims to claim_type == 'write'. The sanctioned worktree flow normally creates 'program' claims with explicit write_paths, so validate_doc_authority can label a plan-index drift unowned while a healthy program claim owns that exact authority path. Ownership checks must recognize every live claim type that carries canonical write ownership, not only the literal write type.

Tailscale Funnel on a shared hostname can publish a new service without replacing existing routes by using 'tailscale funnel --bg --yes --set-path /<path> <loopback-port>'. Verify the full route table before and after, because resetting or rebinding the root would disrupt sibling services; Funnel strips the mounted prefix before proxying, so a static app using relative asset URLs works at the nested path.

Enforced Planning complete_plan.py reaches verification, then crashes in plan_close._default_preflight because it calls session_lifecycle._validate_closeout_preflight without the now-required keyword-only merge_commit argument. This adapter-version mismatch blocks sanctioned plan status reconciliation; pass merge_commit=None for the ordinary ancestor path and retain a regression that executes the dry-run closeout preflight.

Enforced Planning plan-status validators key plan documents only by their numeric filename prefix. When a canonical plan and an auxiliary mockup both use the 66_ prefix but have different lifecycle states, sync_plan_status silently overwrites one file in its number-keyed map and doc_authority compares both files to one index status, so no index row set can satisfy both validators. Numbered plan artifacts need unique identities or an explicit auxiliary-artifact exclusion/relationship instead of sharing a numeric status key.

DIGIMON benchmark observability: a ContextVar trace set in the harness does not cross a stdio MCP subprocess, and consolidated MCP mode can prune reset_question_state from the visible tool surface. Persistent MCP pools should receive an immutable invocation/pool trace in process environment and collectors should pair it with exact question filtering; mutable reset-based propagation risks misattributing late timeout events.

skill-evaluator scripts/aggregate_benchmark.py reads timing.total_tokens only when grading timing reports zero duration. If grading.json already contains duration but not tokens, aggregation skips the sibling timing.json token field and falls back to execution_metrics.output_chars, producing benchmark tables that label character counts as tokens. Read duration and tokens independently, or recover token usage from retained Codex turn.completed events, before using efficiency or cost metrics.

In the humour repository audit, treating the absence of one canonical 80/20 thesis paragraph as evidence that the project needed a new roadmap failed. The feature branch already contained the deductive theory experiment, inductive open coding, 14-pattern synthesis, hypergraph design, analyzer, and generator vertical. Before proposing new planning artifacts, inventory existing plans and executable boundaries separately; weak canonical framing is a documentation issue, not evidence that planning or implementation is absent.

project-meta's render_wiki_artifacts_mediawiki.py iterates every PROJECT_GRAPH.json record and reads each repository's current working-tree documents, while its CLI has no project or revision filter. A one-project wiki refresh can therefore capture unrelated dirty or drifting sibling-repository state; use it only for an intentional full-portfolio reconciliation until generation is project-scoped and revision-bound.

Before opening a replacement planning lane, inspect every registered Git worktree with git status and a diff against the canonical remote. The Stage-1 STA-03G repository had no live claim, but its stale composition-design worktree retained a committed design candidate and a substantially expanded dirty revision; starting fresh would have rebuilt the missing contract and lost exact prior decisions.

Enforced Planning session_lifecycle.close_session writes the claim and tracker to closing before _remove_worktree_path checks whether the caller cwd is inside the target worktree. An inside-worktree plan completion therefore raises after durable mutation and strands the lane in closing; plan_close.close_plan_lanes then rejects closing on retry. Worktree-removal eligibility must fail before lifecycle mutation, and a partially closing lane must remain retryable from the canonical root.

A Tailscale Funnel-backed *.ts.net canonical URL can present as Tailscale-authenticated to a tailnet client while remaining unauthenticated to external clients. Testing authorization only from the operator workstation can therefore misclassify the public boundary. Verify capability flags and protected writes from both a tailnet path and an external path, and include a direct no-identity write probe.

DIGIMON component initialization can succeed while its configured helper model is undispatchable: _ensure_initialized accepted openrouter/openai/gpt-5.4-mini, but the first structured call failed pre-provider with DeprecatedModelError because llm_client hard-blocks GPT-5.4-family routes. Paid sentinels and benchmark launches should preflight the resolved model, fallback chain, and explicit reasoning policy against llm_client execution policy before treating initialization as readiness or starting a spend-bearing run.

Second Brain source-first retrieval: a flat two-token support threshold returned two generic knowledge-base passages alongside the relevant Dagim quote on the tracked 2026-07-17 raw VTT. Removing question-scaffolding terms and requiring two-thirds of meaningful query terms retained the relevant exact span and rejected both generic passages. Evaluate retrieval rules against authentic raw sources before treating fixture success as quality evidence.

humour: JSON Schema and referential graph validation allowed a completed dual_meaning run where lexeme fine was bound to PRIDE and EMBARRASSMENT, then the realizer silently substituted the actual penalty and acceptable-quality readings outside the graph. LLM hypergraph pipelines need mechanism-specific cross-role constraints plus surface-evidence validation; container-schema validity alone does not establish mechanism fidelity.

OneNote GetPageContent XML may place multiple sibling one:OEChildren containers under a single one:OE. Traversing only the first direct one:OEChildren container silently omitted 158 of 2,106 body nodes in the OSD outline. Iterate every direct child group in document order and assert the emitted one:OE count equals the source count.

DoDAF thin.analysis `_reject_conformance_overclaim` originally searched for positive phrases such as `is sufficient to make` without preserving sentence-level negation. The authentic DIGIMON answer `does not establish that ... is sufficient to make` was correctly insufficient but was false-rejected as an overclaim. Overclaim guards for model prose must evaluate sentence/clause polarity and retain the exact live answer as a regression fixture; phrase presence alone is not evidence of a positive claim.

When adding private sources to an artifact store that already contains public graphs, persist the graph access classification before the graph artifact, treat missing access metadata as restricted, and use an explicit one-time migration marker to classify legacy artifacts. CREST's WorkbenchStore follows this ordering so a crash cannot briefly publish a private graph and post-migration unknown artifacts fail closed.

Evaluation gates: a hand-authored positive fixture that calibrates a blind reviewer does not establish build adequacy for the system under test. Before a low-score benchmark can drive a kill/reset decision, run one authentic known-good case through the same application, model, validation, and receipt path; otherwise classify the decision invalid even when held-out failures are consistent.

OSD outline reconstruction showed that equal cardinality is not evidence of source fidelity: a later 28-section chapter taxonomy was labeled 1:1 with a 28-section manuscript summary despite different headings, ordering, and period groupings. Before promoting a normalized outline, validate exact heading-and-order correspondence against the raw source and preserve any mismatch as an explicit derivative delta.

A blank converter artifact is not evidence that the source record is empty. In the OSD corpus, a one-line blank Markdown export led an ingestion log to classify the 35-page summary as absent, while a direct read-only OneNote XML export from the same live page recovered 113,069 characters and 28 sections. Absence claims must name and verify the source boundary; failed or lossy exports stay artifact-level observations.

When docker version reports a Windows client invoked from WSL, Docker Compose does not translate Linux absolute host paths embedded inside a Compose JSON or YAML file: it resolves them under the Compose file directory and produces an invalid UNC path. Detect the Docker client OS and translate build contexts and bind-mount sources with wslpath -w; WSL command-line conversion of the -f argument alone is insufficient.

DoDAF/DIGIMON integration: `llm_client` can durably record a valid structured provider response while the awaiting HTTP request never returns; `LLM_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_POLICY=ban` can also disable the configured client timeout. Provider telemetry therefore proves provider completion only. A consuming application must enforce and test its own terminal deadline, preserve partial deterministic value, and avoid retry before claiming end-to-end completion.

llm_client@554935d5: successful native-schema call_llm_structured rows store a 16-character schema_hash and null call_fingerprint, so get_llm_call_receipts rejects the schema hash against its 64-hex contract and get_runtime_selected_attempt_receipt rejects the absent fingerprint even though the terminal rows and ordinal-0 started→received→validated events reconcile. Trace auditors need the retained low-level rows until the writer and public reader contracts align.

Docker --env-file accepts Docker env-file syntax, not a host credential source containing shell directives such as unset. For CREST promotion, passing the shell-style source directly failed; reusing only the allowlisted application environment keys already present in the prior live container, without printing or persisting their values, produced a valid replacement invocation and preserved the secret boundary.

Treating every non-null plan_ref as proof of graph-coordinated execution rejected simple sequential write claims carrying an exact goal:<outcome-id> unless they manufactured a work graph. In owner-real use, agents preserved goal authority only on a program root and put the actual write paths on an UNPLANNED child. Claim validation must discriminate authority contracts: exact goal refs may own sequential writes, while numbered or qualified plan refs still require an accepted graph and ready unit; test both the positive goal case and a negative numbered-plan control at the actual write claim.

In the source-first Second Brain V2, support integrity and determinism were 18/18 and unsupported abstention was 6/6 while positive exact retrieval was only 5/12. Evidence safety and retrieval usefulness must remain separate hard promotion gates because a system can be perfectly source-faithful yet unusably incomplete.

Git commands that create or modify an independent repository from inside a pre-commit hook inherit the parent hook's repository-local environment (including GIT_DIR, GIT_INDEX_FILE, and GIT_PREFIX). In DoDAF thin/test_acquisition.py this redirected fixture git init/config/commit/tag operations into the linked parent worktree, changed its common config to core.bare=true and a fixture author identity, and appended fixture commits to the feature branch. Subprocess Git boundaries for independent repositories must remove repository-context variables while preserving deliberately supplied transport

A graph-neighbor intersection proves a between/border atom only when each selected edge retains an explicit spatial predicate and candidate-scoped provenance. Bare topology, description-only edges, pooled references, and positional neighbor lists must fail closed; merge path references only from the winning candidate's two endpoint paths.

In humour, generating three surface realizations after one RoleBinding improved mechanism compliance and compression but could not repair semantic premise quality: GPT-5.6 rated the four outputs 7-10 for fidelity and only 4-5 for predicted laughs. When novelty or voice is the bottleneck, diversify semantic bindings upstream instead of adding more phrasings of the same premise.

An exact causal restart replay routed through session_contracts.mutate_session_tracker duplicated no transition history but still rewrote timestamps.updated_at, so the tracker bytes changed despite status=idempotent. Durable idempotence tests must compare exact before/after bytes or digests, and no-op branches must return before generic mutators that always stamp and write.

An empty retained llm_calls list does not prove model-free or no-spend execution when embedding calls are stored in separate embedding telemetry. Before accepting a no-model claim, inspect generative and embedding traces and preflight whether startup and query vector operators require embeddings; fail before runtime when no authorized embedding route is bound.

A source union can legitimately contain failed-import, legacy-prefix, and raw-source locators that do not match the current canonical OneNote path grammar. These records are recovery surfaces: classify and retain their source scope rather than dropping, rewriting, or treating the nonstandard locator as proof that the source is invalid.

In the Original and Sinister Deeds corpus, an OCR sidecar marked HIGH_YIELD records successful text extraction, not relevance to the book. Ranking or placement must use source/log context and structural evidence; treating OCR yield as topical relevance incorrectly promotes operational or off-thread material.

An off-thread disposition is scoped to the review that made it, not a global property of a source. In OSD, WPL When Presidents Lie was non-core to the Farewell proof but is directly cited by the 2020 authorial outline at multiple PAGE/PG nodes. Re-evaluate scoped dispositions against the governing structure before excluding a source corpus-wide.

At Project Graph revision 4cd9bbc, 18 active Brian-owned repositories share repository_governance.owner_class=brian, while the adopted OutcomeContractV1 scenarios use the free caller-supplied label brian-agent-owner and define no product-versus-maintenance lease class. Applying the approved one-product-per-owner-class ceiling without first binding Project Graph owner identity, adding an explicit lease class, and deliberately allocating the slot would either fail to enforce the policy or let the first writer accidentally choose the global Brian portfolio slot.

CREST evidence retrieval showed that lexical passage ranking and answerability classification must remain separate contracts: context-rich passages can be relevant even when they do not contain a requested fact, so retrieval should reject only queries with no meaningful exact concept support and the citation-valid brief should own answered, partial, or insufficient status.

Digimon quick evidence retrieval at provider revision 1d5bcdb67fa8f0f40bdf9ecf8c9629bf821e21b8 can run fully offline with sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 revision 1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41, but the seam requires llama-index-embeddings-huggingface 0.7.0 with the modern Core dependency set, an observed 384-dimension binding, a dimension-aware replacement for FaissIndex._get_index's hard-coded 1024 dimensions, and DIGIMON_QUERY_RERANK=0. Without those controls, installation downgrades llama-index-core, FAISS insertion asserts on 384-vs-1024 vectors, or Quick invokes meta.rer

enforced-planning scripts/merge_pr.py always invokes session_close immediately after a GitHub merge, but a documentation-authority obligation must remain open until its required content is verified on canonical main. When the merging claim owns that authority surface, the safe flow therefore merges successfully and then reports HIGH/incomplete until the obligation is resolved and session_close is rerun manually. The helper needs an explicit merge-without-close phase or another truthful post-merge reconciliation seam.

On Windows with OneDrive Files On Demand mounted through WSL, Linux du can report enormous logical or overflowed directory sizes for cloud-only content (for example the OneDrive archive), which do not represent local C: allocation. agent-skills read_first_gate.py has a mixed-path bypass: _candidate_paths appends the tool cwd only when it finds no absolute /home or ~/ candidate. Pydantic ValidationError.errors() can include exception objects such as ValueError under ctx. Exact-session consumers must use one persistent sanitized codex_home across the whole session lineage; temporary per-call homes are compatible only with intentionally non-resumable calls.

llm_client's Codex CLI session parser reads session identity only from the human stderr header and ignores the standard Codex 0.149 JSONL thread.started.thread_id event. Session-aware runtimes must parse the JSONL identity, require it on successful calls, and validate resume equality or fork inequality against the requested parent before accepting the receipt.

A closeout can name the right user-visible goal and still falsely imply completion when future validation appears only in Recommended next or an agent-resolvable risk appears only in Concerns. Treat the closeout as a cross-field state contract: the dependency-ready next action belongs in Active subgoals, all other actionable or conditional work belongs in Open work, Recommended next may only repeat a tracked item, and Concerns is reserved for non-actionable residual risk.

The Sept. 10 SD - Daily Meeting ended around 09:00 America/Los_Angeles but did not appear in its Slack feed until 10:59. The Slack message body rendered the meeting start as 10:59 without a timezone while Slack's message timestamp was Pacific, making naive comparison misleading. A 10:31 snapshot showed neither the public feed item nor the governed meeting record; both appeared later without intervention. Therefore one missing pre-publication snapshot supported only pending processing, not a Zoom-recording or n8n-publisher failure.

Correction to lrn-20260910T183149156320Z-b4d17349a4: its source_ref names Slack timestamp 1788976782.924809, which was not observed and is wrong. The exact connector-returned source is slack:C0BE2K9LQMC:1789063182.984469, source_event_at 2026-09-10T17:59:42.984469Z. In Team-Brains knowledge/storage/usage.py, adding a duplicate tool-terminal guard before the INSERT path exposed an idempotency contract risk: an exact replay must still return False, while a distinct terminal for the same tool_attempt_id must raise UsageLifecycleConflict. The durable pattern is to resolve and compare the retained idempotency key before applying new lifecycle relationship guards, then keep the relationship checks for genuinely new events.

Enforced Planning coordination claims bind start_revision to the lifetime of the claimed worktree, not to the currently active work unit. During the Team-Brains SBF-03 to SBF-04 transition, refreshing the same live claim with the current branch HEAD was rejected because the claim retained its original start revision. Preserve that original revision when refreshing scope, paths, or work_unit_id; use the new PlanExecutionCursor target_revision to identify the current implementation base.

Plan 134 correctly changed coordination_claims.evaluate_claim so overlapping paths in distinct verified linked worktrees are advisory, but scripts/meta/worktree-coordination/create_worktree.py reconstructs its verification candidate without repo_root. _git_worktree_boundary therefore cannot prove the candidate is a planned linked worktree and the wrapper emits a hard conflict. The regression escaped because Plan 134 added evaluator and claim-bootstrap tests but no positive create_worktree test for two isolated worktrees. My earlier claim that the second writer had to wait was incorrect: policy

I wrote Recommended next as “diagnosis is complete” even though a clear repair remained and the closeout contract requires that field to repeat the current Active subgoal and state whether work continues, is complete, or is blocked. Phase completion is evidence for Done, not a substitute for the next required outcome action.

When a renderer adds a low/medium/high classification, testing only low and high leaves the middle decision boundary unverified. Add a direct assertion for every emitted risk level, including the threshold just below any high-risk cutoff, before treating warning guidance as fully covered.

ecosystem-ops supervisor event deduplication initially matched event_id, event_revision, and decision_digest internally, but the CLI generated a fresh event_id on each invocation, so retrying the same command could never hit that key. Exposing stable --event-id and --event-revision inputs, then repeating the same provider-free CLI command, produced one ledger row with dry_run followed by duplicate. A deduplication contract is only effective when retry-capable producers can preserve every identity component across attempts.

Completing and merging one narrow implementation slice does not complete an authorized session goal. I stopped after the Plan 79 containment slice while still listing managed role-surface reconciliation and the provider-free round trip as active subgoals, even though I needed no human action. The execution loop and workspace closeout contract required me to treat that slice as a checkpoint and continue along safe agent-owned paths; only a named human-owned boundary, scope/authority/spend/safety limit, or genuine circuit breaker licenses stopping.

A UI registry file is not a unique UI. The personal DIGIMON repository and Inside-Success graph-retrieval repository have byte-identical registries declaring the same governed-Ask surface despite different remotes. Build UI inventories from Project Graph canonical paths first, then reconcile registry identity and ownership before counting surfaces.

The initial SBF-04P provider implementation incorrectly treated successful Slack refresh and one-page channel discovery as sufficient evidence for complete source scope. Independent review rejected that completeness claim. The remediation added bounded cursor pagination and explicit discovery-completeness evidence, maps complete only from that evidence, and distinguishes authenticated zero-member discovery (connector available, source_scope unavailable) from provider/auth failure (connector unavailable). Downstream providers must keep connector state, source-scope completeness, refresh degrada

A stale hard-coded GitHub pull-request number can merge an unrelated ready PR. During the UI-index lane, gh pr create returned #1754, but a follow-up merge call targeted #1753, which was a separate Dagim workload-relief update and therefore merged it unintentionally. Verify the created PR number from the command response before any mutation, then query that same number after merge.

Plan 273 WU7 claim readiness rejected a design_revision bound to the tentative feedback-autonomy living supplement. Rebinding the unit to the canonical Plan 273 artifact made the authority chain resolvable. An implementation-authorizing work unit must bind its design_revision to the adopted canonical design/plan; a living supplement can inform the unit but cannot silently replace its authority.

Project Meta plan discovery recursively treats leading-number Markdown filenames as plan identities. Naming a supporting living design 273_feedback_autonomy_living_design.md created a second Plan 273 and triggered ambiguous_plan_identity. Supporting documents under docs/plans must avoid the canonical numeric filename prefix and be linked from the one numbered plan.

A human-owned promotion policy cannot be mechanically evidenced when autonomous agents use the same GitHub administrator identity as the human approver. GitHub sees only the account actor: in the 2026-09-10 Inside Success audit, the agent-used brianmills-spec credential had admin permission on every audited repository, while four implementation repositories had no protected branches or rulesets. Branch protection can require review and remove bypass, but identity separation is still needed to distinguish agent preparation from human promotion.

A condensed session summary marked the presentation signup as uncertain even though the exact thread contained a completed Google Sheets mutation and successful readback. Relying on that summary caused a false claim that the sheet had never been updated and temporarily lost the target link. Before denying, repeating, or reversing a prior external action, inspect the exact thread for its mutation call and receipt and verify the recovered target directly; summaries are navigation aids, not authoritative action ledgers.

A session-close error said an integration branch was missing, and I initially attributed that to the GitHub merge command. Direct show-ref proved the branch still existed. The closeout resolver had instead misidentified a foreign linked worktree nested under project-meta/worktrees as the Project Meta repository, then searched the wrong repository for the branch. Git identity and lexical container layout are independent; diagnose the exact repository identity consumed by a lifecycle guard before repairing branch state.

Retiring the canonical ai-lab repository did not retire its finder reference. Project Meta removed ai-lab from PROJECT_GRAPH.json and deleted BrianMills2718/ai-lab on 2026-09-09, while ecosystem-mega continued tracking repos/ai-lab as a gitlink and .gitmodules URL. A later all-repository fetch therefore reported an unavailable active repository even though the failure was stale aggregator residue. Repository retirement must reconcile aggregator submodule inventories as part of the same lifecycle transaction, or fleet status will misclassify an intentional deletion as a live synchronization fai

The agent-skills SessionStart gate repeatedly reported 14 Cloudflare FORKs because a generic installer had written real package directories into the exclusive symlink-managed client surface. Every new agent session reran the same fail-loud check, so the messages were repeated detection of one persistent ownership collision, not independent agent failures. Moving the copied directories to a recoverable backup and installing the package through each client's native plugin mechanism restored one owner per surface. Future installers should never target an exclusive derived surface directly.

The initiative-roadmap-dashboard originally passed graph data, selection, dependency traversal, and separate-view tests but still presented an administrative card grid rather than the approved gamified Work Map. The stakeholder correctly rejected that as a different product. Technical graph execution does not establish visual parity: when a mockup carries the interaction metaphor, verify its defining semantics in actual browser pixels—here circular work nodes, claimant/avatar occupancy, state lighting, point treatment, path direction, and goal destinations—before calling the implementation com

Team-Brains monday_my_items uses all_items=true to mean every assignee's work, not all statuses or complete history. Dagim's Second Brain used only all_items=true in two separate named-owner workload sessions and returned mixed-owner board items while missing Dagim's 8 active tasks; the production audit recorded 245 board-wide results. A diagnostic call with all_items=false immediately returned 12 Dagim-assigned items (8 active, 4 Done). The parameter name creates a repeatable LLM routing trap, compounded by the tool's ten-most-recent-board and per-board item limits.

I pursued Taulant's Step-0 work as a candidate shared Second Brain implementation review after a meeting described it as a Second Brain implementation and his brain summarized related commits. Brian corrected the classification: it is specialized Claude Code agent definitions. The meeting phrase and commit summary established that work existed, but not its artifact class or adoption scope. Classify the artifact and its intended consumer before opening a cross-person adoption review.

The dashboard's prior Work Map passed its own renderer tests yet was not the canonical Plan 52 DAG: generated/company-work-graph.json still contained an older six-node pilot, and the UI arranged stages without drawing declared dependency edges. Rebuilding from Plan 52 revision 9e5743d, rendering all eight edges, and checking the browser artifact exposed the substitution immediately. A graph consumer needs evidence for both source identity and visible topology; schema-valid nodes or stage columns alone do not establish that it renders the real work DAG.

Brian approved the same Second Brain repair direction repeatedly, but I kept returning another recommended-next checkpoint. His authorization was already clear; the unresolved condition was an active exclusive claim on the overlapping files. Repeated approval cannot release another session's claim, and asking again only transfers internal coordination friction to the user. Once scope is approved, distinguish authorization from write ownership, continue every safe non-conflicting step, and name the exact claim/resume event once rather than soliciting redundant approval.

Setting GH_CONFIG_DIR for mega-sync did not select the Inside Success account because the bare gh executable on PATH was itself a wrapper that unconditionally reset GH_CONFIG_DIR to the personal profile. The environment looked correct at the caller boundary but was overwritten inside the invoked command. Putting the stock gh binary ahead of that wrapper for the one process allowed mega-sync to obtain brianmills-spec credentials and complete.

I initially said modified Team-Brains submodule content blocked the local second-brain-mega synchronization. The timer evidence disproved that as the primary cause: all scheduled runs from September 9 through September 11 exited at mega-sync’s no-GitHub-credential gate before fetch. The submodule residue still needed preservation for a clean checkout, but it did not explain why the superproject remained 34 commits behind.

Fresh configuration inspection showed both hooks are present and point through /home/brian/code/active/enforced-planning, a symlink resolving to the same checkout as the script invoked through /home/brian/code/enforced-planning. check_install constructs one literal SCRIPT_PATH command and uses exact string containment, so equivalent symlink paths are false negatives. Running 'uv run --project ecosystem-ops' without a frozen/no-sync guard attempted to update uv.lock and create a project virtualenv even though the repository was only being consulted as a read-only plan-graph authority. Dependency runners can mutate the consulted repository before the target command starts, so read-only cross-repository execution must account for environment setup side effects.

Plan 135 was merged as a standalone plan file without an entry in docs/plans/CLAUDE.md. The repository plan graph therefore returned missing_plan and correctly denied the implementation lane. A numbered plan must be added to its canonical index in the same admitted planning change before execution can begin.

Plan 135 used the invented Epistemic Planning Frontier state 'human_authorized'. The plan-test checker and framework self-test passed, but plan-bound admission later rejected the merged revision with invalid_frontier_state. Numbered plans need the canonical Planning Integrity validation path before merge because generic checks do not cover the frontier-state schema.

Team-Brains repeats a cross-provider agent failure mode beyond Monday: a broad provider or source universe is bounded before identity filtering or semantic ranking, while the returned object omits collection-level coverage metadata, so an agent can mistake a sample or lookup miss for exhaustive truth. High-confidence current examples are drive_find, which ranks only the first modified-time-ordered Drive page and discards nextPageToken, and slack_search, which stops scanning later channels after early channels fill a hit pool and reports neither omitted channels nor coverage completeness. The first Plan 135 native correction-audit canary failed before model dispatch because scripts/correction_learning_audit.py imported the already-installed enforced_planning package instead of the new module in its claimed worktree. Repository tests passed because pytest added the worktree root to sys.path. Directly executable scripts need an explicit source-root bootstrap and a subprocess execution test, not only import-based unit tests.

The first full Plan 135 canary reported three detected corrections resolved, but its third match was an unrelated later learning about uv lockfile mutation. Same-session identity and timestamp ordering prove provenance, not semantic relevance. The same canary showed 27-67 second batch latency and a later structured ResultError, so this route remains observe-only and cannot enter a Stop hot path.

A work graph's claimability and status describe live execution availability, not merely document progress. PR #461 merged a unit as in_progress/unavailable_active_claim and then released its claim, leaving the graph stale. Closeout must include the graph's post-claim transition in the same lane.

A 36-case synthetic correction-classifier pilot achieved 10/10 correction recall and zero false positives, yet independent sign-off correctly rejected native observe promotion because every case was hand-authored and the aggregate result lacked replayable per-case evidence. A named held-out split does not establish representativeness when the population itself is synthetic.

The ecosystem-ops project-plan API uses project-qualified source references such as ecosystem-ops::docs/plans/1.md and blocks relationships, while work-graph-view/v1 accepts path-safe source_ref values and blocked_by edges. Passing the API values through unchanged silently leaves the shared projection with no nodes; the working adapter canonicalizes the qualified reference to ecosystem-ops/docs/plans/1.md, retains the original under display metadata, and maps blocks to blocked_by. Validate a real consumer payload because a clean provider fixture does not prove source-boundary compatibility.

Inside-Success/llm_client's API-reference generator renders DEFAULT_ROUTING_PATH from the active checkout into docs/API_REFERENCE.html. The same revision therefore fails the generated-doc check across different worktree locations and can publish a machine-specific path. Generated reference values derived from repository roots should be normalized to a stable repository-relative representation before comparison or publication.

The closeout contract's prior focus on in-scope session-goal work allowed material problems exposed during a detour to disappear as optional or deferred. Brian corrected the lifecycle: every material discovered suboptimality must remain visible as an Other subgoal, and Recommended next cannot report completion until the session goal plus Current and Other subgoals are complete. If a local symptom has a credible recurring cause, the root repair in the owning architecture or ecosystem remains open; a local workaround is only mitigation.

During verification of the workspace closeout-rule change, a double-quoted ripgrep pattern contained Markdown backticks around two field names. Bash attempted to execute both names as commands before ripgrep ran. No data changed, but the same shell-substitution failure recurred despite an explicit loaded warning and several prior register entries. Durable prose alone is not a sufficient prevention mechanism; future command construction must avoid shell interpretation for literal search text.

An Enforced Planning lane successfully stored a legacy schema 1.0 outcome selection, but every subsequent session refresh was denied with portfolio_allocation_required because the repository enforces classed selected outcomes. The observe-pilot selection command accepting a legacy scenario does not imply that hard admission can consume it. The empty lane had to be closed and restarted.

Team-Brains' Hermes deployment canary failed three guarded rollouts because mcp_servers[].tools was successively assumed to mean the model-visible shortlist, the post-exclusion participant tools, and the raw FastMCP registry. Inspection of the running Hermes get_mcp_status and registration path proved it counts post-exclusion MCP tools plus four client-created resource/prompt bridges, while tool_search separately reduces the model-visible initial set. The exact production identity was 95 raw server tools, minus 6 participant-profile exclusions, plus 4 Hermes utility bridges, yielding 93 regist

Plan 135's Sonnet classifier scored 10/10 corrections and 0/20 false positives on a frozen held-out synthetic set, but the first pre-registered native replay scored 1/2 correction recall, one false positive across six ordinary non-corrections, and three false positives across five Claude Code protocol-shaped controls. The native failures included a status question paired with an assistant self-correction, a real user correction about uncompleted tracking guidance, and structured-output enforcement traffic. Synthetic separation did not establish safety on the actual event distribution.

Correction to lrn-20260912T013016652935Z-5edf178857: Plan 135's frozen native case cx-brain-01 was not a real user correction. Its scored user turn was the command ; the preceding assistant message acknowledged a correction that had occurred several hours earlier and before the native cutoff. I inferred the label from the assistant acknowledgment instead of verifying the exact adjacent user turn. The corpus therefore contained no valid native positive and its reported 1/2 recall cannot support a generalization claim.

Representation Router weekly-plans browser QA showed that fitting a complete left-to-right workflow graph into a 390px viewport reduced nodes and edge labels to thumbnail scale. A fixed readable zoom focused on the active node, horizontal panning, and hiding secondary edge labels on narrow screens produced a legible mobile control-room view while retaining the full graph.

A stakeholder correction to the weekly-plans visual workbench established that a work dependency graph explains how implementation proceeds but does not explain the architecture of the thing being planned. Planning review needs distinct linked lenses for work structure and system structure, plus an assurance projection that traces requirements to architecture, work, risks, and evidence.

Team-Brains PR #312 passed its branch CI, but combining it with current main made test_the_committed_gate_file_matches_the_registry fail: main had since added monday_board_items to the capability registry while the PR's generated owner_reads projection lacked it. Regenerating tool_tiers.json on the prospective merge tree added the missing owner read and restored 121/121 authorization tests. A green source branch does not validate generated-contract consistency against a moving base; construct and test the prospective merge tree before merge.

In Plan 135's independently labeled 128-case native holdout, the correction classifier detected 10 of 14 corrections. Three Codex misses and one Claude Code miss clustered in messages whose grammatical form was imperative continuation or resumption while their substance also rejected the prior completion/status or required exact repairs; another missed pattern was a short factual/name correction paired with a recurrence-prevention request. Treating continuation, added scope, and correction as mutually exclusive intents systematically hides corrections that are delivered as work instructions.

Plan 135's otherwise valid 128-case held-out run recorded source_revision 65f20a8e2c2314cbb691aa7c25da1a67a85c8374, which does not exist; the actual frozen-corpus commit is 65f20a8bbe81063410921c2ad628df2e3e2af4fc. Its candidate artifacts similarly used a guessed f5680f700c4a development revision instead of the real f5680f7df4088ab2b4336e869c81d79f5664d2b8. Matching content hashes preserved recoverability, but independent sign-off correctly rejected the provenance chain. This repeats the identifier-proofreading failure in lrn-20260909T050656441393Z-25ed3f3b0d; visual inspection is insufficient

The graph-retrieval evidence image declares SOURCE_REVISION before apt and dependency installation, so changing only the revision label invalidated the expensive dependency layers and caused two full production rebuilds. Separately, merging the deployment receipt into graph-retrieval advanced origin/main after a successful exact-main deployment, immediately making the runtime pin stale under the verifier. Keep revision-only OCI metadata after stable dependency layers, and store post-deploy receipts in an external operations ledger or deployment system that does not advance the application sour

A functions.exec call successfully generated the native-v4 disagreement file, then the JavaScript wrapper raised ReferenceError because an accidental trailing identifier remained after the awaited tool expression. Nested command success does not make the orchestration call valid; trailing source tokens must be checked and outputs explicitly verified after any wrapper-level exception.

During a stale-claim recovery I guessed scripts/coordination_claim.py, which does not exist, before inspecting the repository. The supported heartbeat route is the module CLI enforced_planning.coordination_claims --heartbeat; discovering the entrypoint first avoids avoidable failed calls and misleading tool-path assumptions.

Within minutes of recording a practice to discover unfamiliar entrypoints before use, I invoked plan135_native_v4_annotations.py build with guessed named flags although its parser defines positional arguments. The immediate recurrence proves memory and prose are detection aids, not controls; interface discovery must be coupled to command construction or enforced by the helper contract.

I documented native-v4 as 29 corrections, 98 non-corrections, and one ambiguous case, but the executable reconstruction check proved the frozen adjudicated corpus is 29 corrections, 97 non-corrections, and two ambiguous cases. Final counts must be derived from the combined artifact, not inferred from either annotator's summary.

A closeout command composed git fetch and session_close in one shell string with a duplicated separator, so Bash rejected the entire line before either operation ran. This is distinct from the recorded trailing-JavaScript-token failure: here shell composition itself enlarged the failure surface. Separate tool calls structurally eliminate this connector class and make each state transition independently observable.

A compound verification line let a later successful self-test mask an earlier Ruff failure because semicolon-separated commands return the final command status. The same line also masked a failed before-and-after hash assertion around a mutating sync probe, which altered an unclaimed index path until the exact diff was inspected and restored. Evidence-bearing checks and mutations need separate tool calls so each result is independently gating and visible.

In a linked worktree, gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch merged PR #240 remotely but returned exit 1 when its local cleanup tried to check out main, which was already owned by the canonical worktree. A retry then reported that the PR was already merged. The command's failing exit status therefore described local branch cleanup, not the remote merge transaction.

PR 469 attempted to fix post-close canonical-lock reconciliation by resolving canonical_lock.py before worktree deletion and passing that Path afterward. Its new test deleted the fake helper but mocked _reconcile_canonical_lock, so it only proved call order and Path retention, not that subprocess could execute the removed file. The live session-close immediately failed with cannot open file after deleting its worktree and left the canonical checkout locked again. Resolve executable dependencies from a durable location outside the teardown target, and make the regression execute the real subpro

The PR 470 integration test finally executed the retained helper after deleting a real linked worktree, but its scripts/meta variant placed canonical_lock.py under scripts/meta/worktree-coordination. The actual Make target runs scripts/meta/session_close.py while the shared helper remains under scripts/worktree-coordination. The invented symmetric fixture let the resolver pass and the real closeout fail again. Integration fixtures for installed copies must reproduce the installer mapping, especially when entrypoint copies and shared dependencies live at different depths.

enforced-planning's check_coordination_claims.py accepted --project on --list but discarded it when calling check_claims(), so a caller that supplied an exact project bound still received the entire cross-project claim registry. A CLI option is not a context bound until its effect is verified at the serialized output boundary; selector tests should assert excluded records are absent, and large JSON status output should be projected before display.

A structural config search reported the learning gate live while its Stop slot was explicitly disabled and its new prompt slot was untrusted. PR 476 made the check reproduce Codex current hashes and reject disabled, untrusted, or modified exact slots.

This session emitted several malformed function payloads and mistyped CLI commands (including invalid JavaScript object syntax and nonexistent gh subcommands). They failed loudly without state changes, but consumed turns and could have been consequential if a typo formed a valid different command.

A bounded broad-scope claim represents a fixed reservation window, but its ordinary heartbeat inherited renewable-lease behavior and silently moved expires_at beyond the declared bound. PR 478 made heartbeat preserve expires_at for broad_scope_mode=bounded while continuing to renew ordinary claims.

The canonical refresh treated a valid lock receipt as unsynchronizable whenever the target checkout lacked its own copied canonical_lock.py, stranding 10 clean repos even though Project Meta already shipped the same receipt-protocol controller. PR 1779 added the refresher-bundled controller as a fallback while preserving target-local precedence.

The repo refresher classified every shallow checkout as freshness unknown even even when the fetched upstream tip exactly equaled HEAD or Git could prove HEAD was its ancestor. Across 30 shallow active checkouts, this hid 27 conclusive current states and three safe fast-forwards. PR 1780 now accepts only exact-tip identity or an explicit ancestry proof; unconnected shallow histories remain unknown.

A local origin/HEAD symbolic ref can survive deletion or renaming of the remote default branch. The refresher accepted the symbolic name without verifying its target, then only tried main/master; ai-story-tool-v1 therefore stayed unknown even though the remote advertised vm and the local vm branch was safely fast-forwardable. PR 1782 now runs git remote set-head origin --auto, validates the resolved ref, and only then uses conventional fallbacks.

Correction to lrn-20260912T073046325888Z-bc9de8ad30: the intended phrases are "even when" and "any unproven relationship remains unknown." The immutable entry was submitted with duplicated and truncated words because its final prose was not reread before append-only capture.

During a final status check I redirected a controller response into /tmp only to parse it in the next command, despite the workspace rule to avoid shell write tricks when direct command output or an in-memory parse is sufficient. The temporary file was exact-target deleted immediately and contained no credentials.

The durable issue logger had repaired its section anchor but still emitted Markdown hard-break trailing spaces on Observed and Status lines. Project Meta pre-commit runs git diff --check, so every newly generated concern required a manual cleanup before it could land. PR 1783 removed generator-owned trailing whitespace and added a regression across every generated line.

A claim can be live for custody purposes without being eligible for automatic execution. The continuity timer replayed preserved OpenClaw and human-review handoffs because LIVE_STATUSES included handoff and the scheduler treated any nonempty next_action as executable; it also injected multiple unrelated prompts because it scheduled each claim independently even when several belonged to one native Codex session. Only typed active claims should be auto-resumable, while blocked and handoff claims remain explicit-action states, and ambiguous multiple active claims for one session should queue noth

AES Plan 13's first typed feedback artifact was schema-valid but all six useful-task observations carried the planning label plan13-readme-portable-orchestrator instead of the runtime task_id aes-readme-orchestrator-status. Fresh independent verification rejected the terminal review until the identities were joined exactly. Typed schemas establish shape, not referential identity; feedback records must be checked against the durable run source before comparison or policy use.

CORRECTION to lrn-20260908T235505120705Z-5000c7473e: its statement that WORKTREE_DIR needed no override for a consumer-targeted central invocation was false under the then-current Makefile. WORKTREE_DIR was derived from --repo-root . even when WORKTREE_REPO_ROOT named a consumer, so session-close looked under enforced-planning, treated the real consumer worktree as absent, and attempted to delete its checked-out branch. PR #481 derives WORKTREE_DIR from WORKTREE_REPO_ROOT; the new cross-repository expansion test, authentic create/close subprocess round-trip, and the repaired lane's own post-me

The preserving canonical re-anchor correctly created and verified its bundle, patches, dirty-path archive, and durable preserved receipt, but requirement-to-runtime-semantic-compiler has mode-0555 content directories. Git reset then failed with Permission denied after the tool had already cleaned the source branch and switched to main. Recovery remained intact, but the transaction became partial. A recovery-first tool must stage the target and prove all affected existing parent directories are writable before any checkout mutation; repository-root writeability alone is not enough.

A preserving canonical re-anchor archived the detached HEAD, conflict worktree bytes, index patch, and dirty paths for epistemic-contracts, then failed at git switch because .git/rebase-merge showed an active rebase. Branch, HEAD, and porcelain status do not fully describe recoverable Git state: rebase/merge/cherry-pick/revert/bisect/sequencer metadata carries the intended operation and remaining steps. Recovery tooling must detect that state before mutation and include it in the recovery artifact or refuse before changing the checkout.

A shared string placeholder for an unobserved model version is not missing data: it is a false equality assertion. In Plan 13, model_version="observed-name-only" made unrelated unknown versions comparable, so a third verified success could have crossed the routing proposal threshold without any exact version evidence. The durable contract now uses null for unknown version, the scorer excludes those outcomes before grouping, and a three-unknown-version negative test prevents regression.

While adding an active-Git-operation negative test, the patch anchor placed the preceding writeability test's final assertion below the new def. The suite caught a NameError because the assertion referenced a local variable from the prior test. In files with repeated assertion shapes, a successful patch application does not prove function-boundary placement; reopen the entire neighboring def-to-def region and verify assertion ownership before relying on the test run.

The canonical re-anchor writeability preflight falsely refused an untracked symlink named 2nd-brain-plan-repo. pathlib.Path.is_dir follows symlinks, so the check tested write access on the protected target checkout rather than on the writable planning directory that owns the symlink entry Git would remove. Filesystem safety checks must classify is_symlink first; replacement or deletion of a symlink requires its parent directory, not write permission on the target.

While temporarily enabling writes on a protected canonical checkout, a manually assembled chmod argument list accidentally contained a standalone slash. chmod attempted the root directory and the OS refused it; stat confirmed root remained mode 0755. Destructive or permission-changing multi-target commands must not consume a hand-built inline list: validate every canonical absolute path is the intended repository root or its descendant, explicitly reject filesystem root and ancestors, then mutate one exact validated target at a time.

The exceptional re-anchor preflight compared the preserved feature HEAD directly with the remote default, but execution first switched to the stale local default and only then reset to the remote target. In a protected checkout, that unmodeled intermediate branch materialized a different path set and failed on a mode-0555 directory after preservation. A transactional branch re-anchor must not traverse an unapproved intermediate tree: detach directly at the staged target, update the default ref with the exact expected old value, then attach it.

A two-repository weekly-plan consolidation already had an agreed target structure and reversible Git path, but three planning-control PRs were completed before the merged repository was pushed. The user correctly identified that the process had displaced a roughly five-minute outcome. Clear reversible increments should use the minimum safe claim and move directly to the visible artifact; planning machinery is warranted only when unresolved boundaries or coordination change the decision.

prune_merged_worktrees.py has a hand-rolled positional parser and no --help handling. Invoking it with --help silently ignored the flag, defaulted the repository to the current directory, and removed two clean, proven-merged Project Meta worktrees. Conventional help flags are not read-only evidence for hand-rolled maintenance CLIs unless their parser explicitly handles them.

llm_client's max_budget is (a) cumulative across all persisted spend for the trace scope, across runs and processes, and (b) only an admission check before dispatch, so the call it admits can overspend. Only budget_reservation='forecast' gives a hard bound.
